extracted.name: Stovetop Pork Chops and Potatoes
extracted.description: Stovetop pork chops and potatoes simmer with onions in a simple, creamy, yet hearty mushroom sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick cold-night meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray. Add pork chops; brown over medium-high heat.
Flip chops; add onions. Layer sliced potatoes on top of chops; sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Combine soup, water, and milk in a large glass measuring cup; pour into skillet. Add more water or milk to cover potatoes.
Cover skillet; cook until potatoes are tender, about 45 minutes.
